name: asset-l10-dispersal-tower
note: L10 filtration tower (17.8 m) with side duct, riser pipe and catwalks, courier for scale. Look for: no LOD pop, catwalk rings, glowing status slits, plinth grounded. The game camera never zooms out past 1.0 (about 20 m across): pieces taller or wider than that are seen in part, which is the intended monumental read. Framing: the courier stands on the camera side (+X/+Z) of the tower; with the courier behind it the occlusion fade removed the tower from every frame after 0 and zoom 0.5 had a blank first frame.
